_comment: Manual overrides for the generated index. 'label' is the short course name (Intro 1, Data Analysis 3, …), 'order' is the part number used for sorting inside a group, 'data_files' maps the name the notebook's code opens to the file in acc525/data/ (and the helper in acc525/) that the site copies into the sandbox, and 'packages' lists the Pyodide packages the in-browser Python must load before the notebook runs. Keep 'packages' to what Pyodide actually ships: pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scipy, statsmodels, python-calamine (used by pandas' read_excel for .xlsx). Re-run tools/build_index.py after editing.
